markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (58%)** · Unreliable input · Careful review
Reliability flag is set (0.73), and InSitu stays in the conformal set [F1].

## Confidence
|Signal|Value|Reading|
|---|---|---|
|Top probabilities|Invasive 58%, InSitu 37%|Close two-way split|
|Conformal set|InSitu, Invasive (90%)|Cannot separate the two|
|Reliability / OOD|0.73 / 94th percentile|Flagged; atypical image [F6]|
|Second-model (MUSK) agreement|No|Different top class|
|Similar cases|2 of 5 Invasive|Weak support [F5]|

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 4, 8, 11) · ↑ invasive · Above typical; strongest concept association [F2] · Validated
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 8, 9, 11) · ↑ invasive · Above typical score [F4] · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 2) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score, yet a positive term; nearest InSitu case scores higher · Weak
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 8, 9) · ↑ invasive · Above typical score; failed spot check (3/20) · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI (−0.005 to 0.007) includes 0, so not shown to reflect the classifier; necrosis is Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Image is atypical (94th percentile OOD); a recut or deeper levels may change the read.
- Second model disagrees, and 3 of 5 similar cases are InSitu.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 4, 8, 11** — confirm tumor cells infiltrate stroma rather than stay within ducts.
2. **Regions 6, 10** — region 6 ranks second on the heatmap; region 10 is near even (0.49).
3. **Region 2** — check whether atypical cells remain confined within ducts.
